note: The carried set is every document `backends/go/emit.py::emit` routes to
OBSERVABLE component (issue #1321). `carried` has to mean `builds`, so
tests/test_go_carried_set_builds.py emits the whole set and runs
`go build` over it. Every carried document that emits must build unless
it is named here, with the diagnostic it still produces.
All but the named documents build (issue #1356; empty until issue #1892). It
stays a RATCHET. Removing an entry is the only edit that needs no
argument. Adding one needs the reason in the entry and an issue behind
it: a carried document that does not build is a defect, not a baseline.

known_bad.tests/fixtures/emit_rust_corpus/bridge_t: issue #1892 - `undefined: Result; undefined: Any; undefined: Any`. The go tier's component-dialect `_go_type` has no `Any` arm and no value-position `Result` arm, so a service method taking a `Result[Int, Str]` or `Any` prints the surface spelling into its Go signature. The document is a rust byte-agreement corpus case (item 391, #1816) that reaches the combined go renderer only because it declares top-level record types beside its component.
